title: Fourier formula for BLR acceptance
statement:
Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2$. The BLR acceptance probability is the probability, for independent uniform $x,y\in\mathbb F_2^n$, that $f(x)+f(y)=f(x+y)$; if $F(x)=(-1)^{f(x)}$ and $\widehat F(S)=\mathbb E_x[F(x)(-1)^{\sum_{i\in S}x_i}]$ for each subset $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, then
\[2\Pr[f(x)+f(y)=f(x+y)]-1=\sum_{S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}}\widehat F(S)^3.\]
